spec.assertion: buffApply stat defPct value 19.02 reaches every comp member, and its wave count (applications / distinct targets) sits in 4..80 — i.e. once per magazine over 180 s. Fails under the nearest-wrong self-only target (distinct targets == 1) and under a shotFired/interval keying (~10^3 waves). A third assertion pins the line's inertness: deleting the effect must leave totals() byte-identical (defPct feeds no damage bucket in v1), and the deletion count must be > 0 so a MISSING line also goes RED.

spec.kitLine: ally uses Burst Skill -> Shopping DEF 1.33%
spec.assertion: At least 3 Shopping waves land BEFORE the first fullBurstStart, because the B1->B2->B3 casts all precede FB entry. RED under fullBurstEnter keying (0 applications before the first FB start) and RED under own-burstCast keying (the fixed B1 wins stage 1 on slot order, so she never casts in the control comp -> 0). Target set pinned to all allies; per-application value pinned to 1.33.

spec.kitLine: Stacks up to 4, lasts for 20 sec
spec.assertion: buffApply.stacks tops out at exactly 4 and maxStacks (where emitted) is 4. RED under a collapsed model that applies one 5.32% (4x1.33) buff, under an uncapped stack model, and under a maxStacks mismatch. The 20 s window is not asserted directly — there is no buffRemove on natural lapse, and at ~3 casts per rotation the buff never lapses, so a duration assertion would be vacuous.

spec.kitLine: max stacks at FB end -> gauge speed 7.9%
spec.assertion: The first burstGenPct 7.9 application must be preceded by >= 2 fullBurstStart events: rotation 1 banks only 3 stacks (3 burst casts), so the max-stacks condition cannot hold at the first Full Burst end. An ungated fullBurstEnd model fires after start #1 -> RED. Counting fullBurstStart rather than fullBurstEnd removes any same-frame event-ordering assumption. A counterfactual then strips every block-level gate from the carrier and must yield strictly MORE applications, proving the gate is load-bearing rather than decorative. Target set pinned to all allies.

Applied to every comp member at value 63.17, and damage-positive: dropping it lowers BOTH team total and her own totalDamage (reload speed gates shots fired — it is not a defensive no-op). RED if modeled self-only (target count 1), if dropped entirely (removal count 0), or if the engine treats reload speed as damage-neutral.

In the burstFirst fixture she consumes stage 1; with reenterStage present the fixed B1 buffer still casts, without it that ally never casts at all, so team total with the effect must strictly exceed team total without it. RED if reenterStage is absent (removal count 0) or if the effect is inert in the rotation state machine.
it.skip — no aggro/threat primitive exists and the v1 boss deals no damage, so the line has no observable payload and no consumer. Belongs in the override's unmodeled.burst.

spec.kitLine: Recovers 50.47% of atk dmg as HP/10s
spec.assertion: it.skip — the heal primitive models no HP amount and cfg.onEvent exposes no recovery/heal event kind, so a SELF-targeted heal is unobservable here; she carries no `recovery` trigger to consume it. Still kit-required for completeness (a future teammate with an on-recovery trigger would read it), so it should be present as a heal effect with ticks over the 10 s window and verified by inspection, not by simulation.

fixtures: Skill-slot assertions: controlComp('rupee-winter-shopper', true) unpatched — fixed B1/B2/B3 so bursts actually chain and Full Bursts occur (she is Burst I; a lone-B3 concern does not apply, but the fixed slots supply the three burst casts per rotation that the S2 lines key off). Burst-slot assertions: the same comp with an in-memory `burstFirst` effect appended to her burst block, because as a Burst I unit she loses the stage-1 slot to the fixed B1 on slot order and would otherwise never cast — the patch is a FIXTURE CONTROL applied identically to the baseline and to every counterfactual, so the deltas still isolate the effect under test; non-vacuity is asserted via the presence of her Reload Speed application. All counterfactuals are built with withPatchedOverride and mutate blocks in place through a shape-agnostic reader (slot as Block[] or as CharacterSkills.blocks), matching effects by kind/stat/value rather than by index so the driver's block layout cannot silently make a patch a no-op — every patch also asserts its own removal/addition count > 0. 6 hoisted 180 s runs total.
gaps: burst / Attract taunt 5 sec — it.skip: no aggro or threat primitive in the effect schema, and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so nothing can consume a taunt (unmodeled.burst material).

burst / 50.47%-of-attack-damage HoT over 10 sec — it.skip: `heal` emits no HP amount and no recovery/heal event kind is exposed on cfg.onEvent; the line is self-targeted and she carries no `recovery` trigger, so it has no observable payload in any available fixture. Verify by override inspection (heal with ticks across 10 s) rather than by simulation.

skill2 / Shopping 20-sec duration — not asserted: the engine emits no buffRemove on natural time lapse, and at ~3 ally burst casts per ~20 s rotation the stacks refresh before expiry, so any expiry assertion would be vacuous in this fixture. Would need a comp with a deliberately long burst-cast gap to become non-vacuous.

skill2 / max-stacks gate counterfactual — known false-positive risk: the ungate patch strips block-level gate FIELDS (resourceGate/everyN/ownBurstGate/...). If the driver expressed the max-stacks condition some other way (e.g. a bespoke trigger kind), the strip is a no-op and the assertion goes RED despite a faithful model. The independent ordering assertion (>= 2 fullBurstStart before the first gauge apply) is the primary discriminator and does not carry this risk.
skill1 / DEF magnitude — the 19.02% value cannot be discriminated by damage (defPct is inert in v1); only its presence, target set, cadence and inertness are testable.
